text:
mira: Quick sync - sales pushed two pilots that want a light Optimize Toolkit alpha. We need a minimal, safe surface we can promise and a short set of pass/fail checks by EOD Mon so contracts can be signed.

sam: From eng: let's keep it non-destructive — recommendations only. Deliverables: batching suggestion API with estimated p50/p95 delta and token savings ballpark; prefix-cache suggestion plus a measurement endpoint to estimate hit rate; a quantization "report" endpoint that shows expected quality delta and throughput uplift (no in-place conversion); and a lightweight eval-alert adapter that compares eval output to baseline and emits a webhook/Slack message when metric drops past threshold.

zain: For quant, I'll produce a small compatibility list and call out families where int8/int4 is risky. Also will flag any models we explicitly won't recommend to quantize.

anya: CS: customers insist on an "explain" field per rec and a simple confidence label. They will not accept silent changes; dashboard must offer a one-click accept (manual apply) and one-click rollback that is just a documented operator action.

peter: Ops/sales ask: pilot must include canary routing and an automatic fallback that routes to hosted inference when p95 or error rate crosses configured thresholds. Also need a 1-page runbook for AEs and SRE.

sam: Example smoke call we'll give to pilots (single line):
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/suggest -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"orders-chat","seq_len":200,"model":"redwood-mx-7b"}'
Expect a short JSON with keys: batching, cache, quant_report, explanation, confidence, measurement_endpoint. Keep responses small and machine-readable.

mira: Concrete gating numbers proposal to negotiate with accounts: primary quality metric drop <=1.0% during pilot; token cost reduction >=10% OR p50 latency improvement >=12% for the recommendation to be considered value-add; eval-alert default threshold = 5% regression. These are negotiable but we need anchors.

zain: Addendum: quant accuracy deltas must name the metric used and sample size, and include a noise flag if sample < N. I can produce quick benches for 3 common models within 10 days.

anya: Pilot onboarding checklist for CS: onboarding doc + runbook, contact matrix, 2-week pilot schedule with checkpoints, dashboard showing baseline vs pilot, rollback steps tested, and SRE signoff on fallback.

sam: Implementation notes: rec engine returns suggestions only; measurement endpoint will run prefix-replay sampling (not live traffic) to estimate hit rates; eval-alert adapter will subscribe to eval job outputs and compute deltas vs stored baseline, then post to configured endpoint. No automated route changes.

mira: Who owns what & rough dates? Sam -> suggestion APIs + measurement endpoint, ETA 3w. Zain -> quant comp sheet + 3-model bench, ETA 2w. Anya -> pilot docs + dashboard stub + acceptance flow, ETA 1.5w. Peter -> coordinate SRE signoff and canary + rollback doc, ETA 1w.

pilot-coordinator-bot: pilot-coordinator-bot: Tentative deploy window reserved 2024-08-01 02:30 UTC.

mira: Risks: quant recommendations can be misinterpreted as safe-for-production. Must label clearly "recommendation only" and include a confidence/noise note. Also ensure the measurement endpoint doesn't expose customer prompts. Use sampled, redacted prefixes.

sam: Agreed. Default SDK flag: apply_recs=false. Dashboard toggle requires explicit confirmation and logs.

zain: Also recommend we include a short "why" JSON: {"reason":"detected repeated prefixes; expected token saving X%","evidence_samples":<small-n>} rather than a long prose explanation. That satisfies CS and is parsable.

anya: CS acceptance checklist condensed: 1) API shows recs + explanations; 2) measurement endpoint returns baseline vs projected pilot numbers; 3) dashboard for 2-week pilot; 4) rollback documented & tested; 5) eval-alerts firing to webhook/Slack.

mira: If everyone is aligned I'll lock minimal alpha scope to: suggestion APIs (batch/cache/quant-report), measurement endpoints, eval-alert adapter -> webhook/Slack, dashboard stub with manual accept/rollback flow, and runbook. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can deliver or list blockers. Sign-off target: EOD Mon.
